title: Artificial intelligence-assisted ultrasound image analysis to discriminate early breast cancer in Chinese population: a retrospective, multicentre, cohort study.
summary: The AI-assisted ultrasound system combined learned image representations from paired views to distinguish lesions classified as benign on initial ultrasound that were later diagnosed as malignant at pathology or follow-up. This retrospective, selected cohort result includes external hospital assessment but does not show outcome benefit or new biology.
ai_technology: A deep model extracted paired ultrasound-image features for lesion classification.
